channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 November 2026 Cut-Off)
item.description: The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Lytton Plaza Installation Commission (USD 20,000)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · USD 20,000 commission budget. No application fee.

item.title: City of Palo Alto Code:ART 2027: Interactive Media Installations (up to USD 9,000 each)
item.description: City of Palo Alto Public Art Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 9,000 per installation, for up to five installations. No application fee.

item.title: Collective Power Fund 2026: Grants for King County Artists (USD 5,000 to 10,000)
item.description: Northwest Film Forum (Warhol Foundation Regional Regranting Program) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 60,000 distributed in total: one USD 10,000 grant for an artist team or artist-run collective, and ten USD 5,000 grants for new works or projects by individual artists.

item.title: LA Department of Cultural Affairs: NEAR + CO-UP Artist Residency Grants 2027-28
item.description: City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs (DCA) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · NEAR grants of USD 12,000 for individual artists; CO-UP grants of USD 15,000 for collaborations between social-justice nonprofits and artists. No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council Individual Fellowship 2027 (up to USD 35,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.title: LMCC Manhattan Arts Grants: Creative Engagement 2027
item.description: Lower Manhattan Cultural Council (LMCC) · deadline 12 Nov 2026 · USD 1,000 to 20,000 per grant for public arts events in Manhattan between January and December 2027. No application fee.

item.title: Burning Man: BRC Honoraria Art Grants 2027 (Letter of Intent)
item.description: Burning Man Project · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · USD 1.5 million annual art-grant budget across approximately 75 projects; grants fund 40 to 60% of the proposed total budget, and the official page notes grants over USD 20,000 are rare. No fixed per-award figure is published. No application fee.

item.title: Puffin Foundation: Grants 2027 cycle (Film/Video and Theater)
item.description: Puffin Foundation Ltd. · deadline 20 Nov 2026 · Maximum grant USD 3,500; typical awards smaller. No application fee.

item.title: Beam Center: 2027 Beam Camp Project Open Call (USD 5,000 commission, remote-friendly)
item.description: Beam Center · deadline 30 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 award to the selected proposer, plus a fabrication budget of approximately USD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: Mid Atlantic Arts: USArtists International (FY28 round, up to USD 11,000)
item.description: Mid Atlantic Arts, with the National Endowment for the Arts and the Mellon Foundation · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · Grants of up to USD 11,000 toward eligible expenses, with a 1:1 cost match required. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund (research grants on AI's economic impacts)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 200 million committed overall. Grants primarily in the USD 5-30 million range per project, with a USD 1 million minimum and flexibility upward for well-scoped, high-potential-impact projects. The separate small-grant Research Awards tier (USD 10,000-50,000 plus USD 5,000 in Claude API credits) is currently paused. No application fee.

item.title: Pedantic Arts Residency and Research Grant 2027 (Pittsburgh)
item.description: Pedantic Arts Residency · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Residency: free furnished housing in a shared apartment plus a USD 2,000 living stipend (half on arrival, half on completion). Research Grant: a free private bedroom at the Pedantic Apartment plus a USD 500 or USD 1,000 honorarium at the grantee's discretion. Application free until 28 September 2026, then USD 20.

item.title: Gurl Grant: USD 2,500 for female and non-binary short film directors
item.description: Gurl Grant (Kat VanCleave) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 2,500 cash grant toward the production of a narrative short film, awarded twice yearly. No application fee.

item.title: No Drama 2.0: USD 50,000 horror short film initiative (Monkeypaw x Universal x American Cinematheque)
item.description: Monkeypaw Productions, Universal Pictures and American Cinematheque · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Up to three filmmakers each receive USD 50,000 to fund production of a short film / proof of concept, plus mentorship from Monkeypaw, Universal and American Cinematheque executives, eligibility to screen at Beyond Fest 2027, and first-look consideration from Universal Pictures and Monkeypaw. No application fee.

item.title: Black Public Media: BPM Open Call 2026 (USD 20,000 for nonfiction features)
item.description: Black Public Media · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · USD 20,000 in production funding for up to five projects, each also invited to pitch at PitchBLACK in June 2027, where one project receives an additional USD 150,000 award. Structured as licensing agreements for public media distribution. Free to apply.

item.title: AAPI Fund: Creative Catalyst Fellowship 2027 (theme Belonging)
item.description: AAPI Civic Engagement Fund · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to eight artists each receive USD 30,000 to produce new work. Also covered: the two-day Fellows retreat (travel and accommodation paid by the AAPI Fund), an accomplished communications consultant, digital advertising, community introductions, exhibition placement support and replica development (posters, books, calendars) promoting the finished work. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Museum: BRAIN Digital Content Open Call
item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Flat honorarium of USD 2,500 to 5,000 per selected proposal, at the Museum's discretion

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track I: Local Compute
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant (larger possible for the right project), plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track II: Coordination and Accountability
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with smaller amounts for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance & Open Governance focus areas; plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track III: AI-First Science (Bio, Neuro, Nano)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with higher amounts for this track than the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance areas (larger possible for the right project); plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. In 2026, 31 American Fellows received over USD 277,390 in total funding. Awards are given in all fields, including creative arts projects.

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: Netflix x NALIP Director Incubator 2026-27 (short film grants)
item.description: NALIP (National Association of Latino Independent Producers) with Netflix · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 45,000 production grant for each of four selected directors to create an original narrative short film, plus individualized guidance, career development opportunities, and an industry showcase. No application fee, but current NALIP membership is required to apply.

item.title: Frameline Completion Fund 2027
item.description: Frameline · deadline 09 Oct 2026 · Grants of up to USD 5,000, with a standard range of USD 1,000 to 5,000; the jury can recommend amounts above or below that range. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science & Safety Nodes RFP
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Typically $30,000 to $100,000 per grant, with smaller amounts for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance & Open Governance focus areas and higher amounts for the rest (larger possible for the right project), plus private local compute and workspace at the San Francisco or Berlin AI Nodes. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Travel Fellowship 2026
    https://www.lasellefoundation.org/travel-fellowship
    Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Foundation · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Two awards of USD 5,000 each, distributed in the fall of 2026, to fund a research trip that furthers the artist's practice. No application fee.
  • Arts in Community Grants 2027
    https://www.southarts.org/grants-opportunities/arts-community-grants
    South Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to USD 10,000 per project, covering artist fees. A dollar-for-dollar cash match is required, so a USD 10,000 request needs USD 10,000 in matching funds. Minimum artist fee is USD 4,000 and the minimum grant request is USD 2,000. No application fee.
  • Guggenheim Fellowship 2027
    https://www.gf.org/program/how-to-apply/
    John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Variable cash grant sized to the applicant's proposed budget and needs; the Foundation does not publish a fixed figure or range, and recent awards have typically run into the tens of thousands of US dollars. Roughly 175 to 200 fellowships are awarded each year across more than 50 fields. The Foundation charges no application fee and has no affiliated application consultants.
  • ACLS Digital Justice Grants 2026-27 (Seed and Development)
    https://www.acls.org/programs/acls-digital-justice-grants/
    American Council of Learned Societies (ACLS), funded by the Mellon Foundation · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · Seed Grants USD 10,000 to 25,000 for start-up and prototyping work; Development Grants USD 50,000 to 100,000 for projects past proof of concept. Institutional indirect costs are not covered. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Andy Warhol Foundation: Exhibition Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/exhibition-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000. Direct costs only (artist payments, catalogue and publication, artist-designed public programmes); staff salaries excluded. Request must not exceed 25 percent of total direct project costs, which functions as a de facto 75 percent co-financing requirement. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Multi-year Program Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/multi-year-program-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000 across two years. Request must not exceed 25 percent of the organisation's annual operating budget. No formal match, but the 25 percent cap means the balance must come from elsewhere. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Project Grants for Small-Scale Organizations (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/project-grants-for-small-scale-organizations/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 20,000 to 30,000 toward direct costs such as artist payments and production. No application fee.
  • Alicia Patterson Fellowship 2027 (Fund for Investigative Journalism)
    https://investigate.submittable.com/submit/355041/alicia-patterson-fellowship-2027
    Fund for Investigative Journalism (Alicia Patterson Foundation program) · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · $40,000 (12-month fellowship) or $20,000 (6-month fellowship), paid monthly; covers living and reporting costs
  • Pandora Short Film Grant 2026
    https://pandora.org/
    Pandora Short Film Grant · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · $12,000 production grant to the winner, plus a Panavision camera package (worth about $15,000), an optional $1,000 Kodak Film Grant toward film stock and lab expenses, mentorship from an award-winning filmmaker, and fiscal sponsorship. Three finalists receive mentorship, fiscal sponsorship, consideration for the Panavision New Filmmaker Program, and $500 off Athos production insurance. ENTRY FEE: tiered, $30 regular ($27 Gold members) and $40 late ($36); Pandora states fee waivers are available on request.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Cafe Royal Cultural Foundation: Performance Grant (Summer 2026)
    https://caferoyalculturalfoundation.org/performance-page
    Cafe Royal Cultural Foundation NYC · deadline 03 Aug 2026 · Up to $10,000 for production costs (performers, collaborators, rehearsal and venue rental, design elements, technical staff, etc.). Does not fund the creation or composition of new work. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Alabama Historical Commission: Clotilda Memorial Public Art Commission
    https://www.codaworx.com/rfp/
    Alabama Historical Commission (with Forecast Public Art) · deadline 09 Aug 2026 · USD 2,000,000 total project budget for a paid public art commission. No application fee.
  • Queer|Art Design Grant 2026 (Inaugural)
    https://www.queer-art.org/design-grant
    Queer|Art (in partnership with UGG) · deadline 14 Aug 2026 · Two USD 10,000 grants (described as the largest cash grant for LGBTQ+ designers in the US). No application fee.
  • Field of Vision: Documentary Commissions (Rolling)
    https://fieldofvision.org/submit
    Field of Vision · deadline Rolling / undated · Commissioning fees and production funding (many films are commissioned assignments); specific amounts are not published publicly. No submission fee.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Open Interval: An Artist-Scientist Exploration of Turbulence
    https://www.simonsfoundation.org/2026/06/01/coming-soon-open-interval-an-artist-scientist-exploration-of-turbulence/
    Simons Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · USD 30,000 per awarded trio

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Letters to Strangers Mental Health Scholarship 2026
    https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScf0uJR32jmPQvHtJBAPdp_yd2nJFv1EbYtnfpj08nrQKeU_Q/viewform
    Letters to Strangers · deadline 30 Jun 2026 · Up to USD 8,000 toward education.
  • MSB Interpretive Panels: Public Art Commission (Creative Philadelphia)
    https://oacce.submittable.com/submit/357418/msb-interpretive-panels
    Creative Philadelphia (Office of Arts, Culture and the Creative Economy) · deadline 12 Jul 2026 · Total project budget of USD 250,000, which must cover: artist fees (18% design fee), design and engineering, fabrication and installation, structural footings/anchoring, travel and site visits, AR development (software, hosting, content production), insurance (1%), community engagement participation, and a service warranty keeping content compatible with new mobile OS versions for a minimum of 10 years. No application fees.
  • The Center for Fiction / Susan Kamil Emerging Writer Fellowship
    https://centerforfiction.org/grants-awards/nyc-emerging-writers-fellowship/apply-to-the-nyc-emerging-writer-fellowship/
    The Center for Fiction · deadline 31 Jul 2026 · USD 5,000 grant plus writers studio space, mentorship, agent introductions, and community programming
